sections.title: World Cup 2026: R32 Knockout Stage Update

items.headline: No Round of 32 Matches Scheduled for July 1st
items.body: Today, July 1st, 2026, marks a brief pause in the World Cup 2026 knockout stage schedule. Fans can anticipate the resumption of thrilling Round of 32 encounters in the coming days as teams prepare for high-stakes elimination football.
